release_notes: Build 122 turns Library into the first content-management view without adding another sidebar page or another lifecycle database.
Every quiz now receives a derived Stage and Next action from existing Quiz History, canonical publication state and local rendered-video availability.
Workflow filters let Library show All, Needs attention, Scheduled, Published, Uploaded, Rendered or Exported quizzes, with live visible and attention counts.
Publication failures take priority, scheduled quizzes detect missing project folders, and historical published quizzes are not incorrectly marked broken when old local folders have been archived.
Existing Questions, Metadata, Publication State, YouTube, Folder and More actions continue to use the original Quiz History records unchanged.
